description.narrative: In August 202, the Cabinet tasked the Ministry of Local Government and Rural Development (MLGRD after the adoption of the National Social Protection Framework (NSPF),) to develop a plan for its implementation. In November 202 an implementation plan was developed and is being implemented. This Plan, prepared by MLGRD with support of the UN in Botswana, sets out the actions that are required to operationalise the NSPF's Vision: "To establish a comprehensive and well-coordinated social protection system that is efficient, effective and sustainable". The Plan sets out a programme of reform over the next ten years including strengthening of a national coordination mechanism, management information system, a more comprehensive monitoring and evaluation system and improvement in the administrative system to enhance service delivery at all levels of programme interventions. The UN in Botswana developed the Implementation Plan, under the leadership of UNDP. The ILO played an active role in the process, including review and input to documents and participation in meetings with Government and stakeholders.

description.narrative: In August 2020, the Cabinet approved a new National Social Protection Framework (NSPF) for Botswana. The NSPF adopts a life-course approach to enhance social protection for children, adolescence, the working age population, people with disabilities and older persons. The NSPF was one of the highlights of State of the Nation Address by His Excellency the President on 9 November 2020. NSPF sets out better programming and delivery mechanisms including a Single Registry System with the aim of consolidating and harmonising the existing twenty-nine (29) Social Protection programmes across Government into five Life Course programmes. The coordination and consolidation of the programmes improve coherence and synergies between programmes towards a stronger, more responsive, efficient and resilient social protection system. During the biennium, technical support was provided towards the development of Policy framework for Social Protection.
